text:
maria: quick sync — legal flagged two things from the EU bank pilot: retention SLAs (they need 7y opt-in) and an escrow policy for BYOK keys. can we scope for q2?
ajay: 7y is heavy for hosted. cost + infra implications. we should differentiate hosted vs dedicated/private. :thinking_face:
leah: agree. propose defaults: hosted = 90 days, enterprise paid tier = 365 days, private = customer-managed up to 7 years with legal sign-off.
samir: +1 to tiers. question on BYOK escrow: are they asking Redwood to hold key escrow? that is a no-go unless contractual and HSM-backed.
maria: @samir correct. legal says some customers require an escrow option for key recovery in extreme cases. they asked whether we can offer an escrow flow for Dedicated/Private only.
kai: technical note: supporting escrow means supporting wrapped key import/export flows and KMS provider neutral APIs. This impacts onboarding and rotation.
leah: rough acceptance criteria for a beta: 1) API to set retention per-org (`retain_days`) 2) Console toggle for org admins 3) KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure) + docs for BYOK import/export 4) audit log export and immutable storage for retention window 5) e2e tests and legal sign-off for escrow.
ajay: timeline: I can spike API + infra changes in 2 weeks, then 4w to finish. need to know if escrow is in-scope for beta — if yes, add 2w for HSM onboarding.
maria: decision: beta excludes automated escrow by Redwood for hosted. Beta will include BYOK integration (customer-held keys) for Dedicated/Private and a manual escrow option only under contract.
samir: note for sales: manual escrow = paper process + separate SOW. I'll draft language and flag pricing.
kai: sample API (for spec):
```
POST /v1/orgs/:org_id/settings/retention
{
  "retain_days": 365,
  "kms_provider": "aws-kms",
  "key_id": "arn:aws:kms:..."
}
```
leah: UI notes: only org admins see retention setting. default read-only for free accounts. show cost estimate when they increase retention >365.
maria: launch gating checklist (must pass before GA):
- docs + security review :white_check_mark:
- e2e retain/restore test :white_check_mark:
- canary with 2 pilot customers :in_progress:
- legal escrow SOW template :needs_work:
- metrics: retention storage cost per-org + alerts when thresholds hit :needs_work:
ajay: infra constraints: we need lifecycle housekeeping jobs with prioritization and cost tags. also ensure KV cache not affected by retention policy.
kai: security-bot: ran quick policy diff — adding retention config requires additional logging (who changed, when) and tamper-evident markers. will add to audit plan.
samir: action items: @leah own spec + acceptance tests (due EOW), @ajay spike + infra estimate (2w), @maria coordinate pilot customers and legal (this week), @kai add audit controls and run threat model (next sprint).
leah: noted. will create RFC and link to this thread.
maria: thanks. small ask — can we include ISO mapping in the RFC? customers asked how this maps to SOC2/ISO controls.
leah: yes — will map retention + key management to ISO 27001 A.8/A.12 and SOC2 CC6/CC7 in the doc.
ajay: +1, and will add a runbook for retention reclaim failures.
maria: perfect. let's reconvene after specs posted. :thumbsup:
security-bot: created ticket INF-2387 for "retention + BYOK escrow triage" and assigned to @leah and @ajay.
